title: TABLE 57 MISSILE SPECIALIZATIONS - the specialist attacks-per-round grid
audit_comment: OA round thirty-eight (capture p. 100): Table 57 - the missile weapon specializations grid, the specialist attacks-per-round pairs by level band

banner.title: TABLE 57 MISSILE SPECIALIZATIONS, printed capture pp. 100-101 - the OA missile specializations round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the section - the Table 57 grid cross-checked cell-by-cell between the two passes (the table opens on capture p. 100 of the print pass with the Number of Attacks Per Round With header and its column-name fragments, the full grid printing on p. 101; compressed p. 52); every printed cell agrees - zero contested cells. The grid pins per the T55 pair precedent: each printed num/den attacks pair becomes a numerator and a denominator column, the level rows 0 the 1-6 band, 1 the 7-12 band and 2 the 13-and-up band riding the first column comment, and the level-band bounds pin as consts (three bands, tops at 6 and 12). The seven printed columns: the bow (2/1, 3/1, 4/1 up the bands), the light crossbow (1/1, 3/2, 2/1), the pellet bow and heavy crossbow (1/2, 1/1, 3/2), the lasso and staff sling (1/1, 3/2, 2/1), the large shuriken and thrown dagger (3/1, 4/1, 5/1), the dart and small shuriken (4/1, 5/1, 6/1) and the other column (3/2, 2/1, 5/2). Two column-name reads settle from the print pass's own p. 100 header fragments plus the compressed corroboration: the p. 101 header reads Bow & Heavy Crossbow and Shuriken, Thrown Dagger, dropping the Pellet and Large that the p. 100 fragments carry - the names pin as pellet bow & heavy crossbow and large shuriken & thrown dagger. The specialist-prose cross-references stay with R650; the grid completes the weapon proficiencies arc of Chapter 6
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 103 closed, 132 open - the Table 57 box flips (census 573 -> 574); NEXT - R652: the Non-Weapon Proficiencies prose with the optional peaceful proficiency bonuses, the success-and-failure doctrine and the contests (capture pp. 101-103), prefix dhm (verify free), audit "R652 OA non-weapon proficiencies audit", include after rules/oamslspec.h
